# tensor

Arrays and differentiable primitives, numpy and torch.Tensor style: the `Tensor` type, dtypes, shapes and broadcasting, primitives with their derivative rules, backends, the operations (arithmetic, reductions, indexing, linear algebra basics) and pytrees. The `ops` folder is part of this entry point.

- function `create.ts` (file): Tensor constructors: zeros, ones, full, arange, linspace, eye. `src/lib/tensor/create.ts:1` `mdml-engine/tensor`

- structure `complex.ts` (file): Complex tensors held as real and imaginary pairs, still differentiable. `src/lib/tensor/complex.ts:1` `mdml-engine/tensor`
- structure `tensor.ts` (file): The Tensor type, its constructors and conversions to plain arrays. `src/lib/tensor/tensor.ts:1` `mdml-engine/tensor`

- function `definePrimitive`: Declare a new operation with its kernel and derivative rules. `src/lib/tensor/primitive.ts:82` `mdml-engine/tensor`
- function `tensor`: Create a tensor from numbers or nested arrays, like numpy.array. `src/lib/tensor/tensor.ts:90` `mdml-engine/tensor`
- function `treeMap`: Map a function over the leaves of nested arrays and records. `src/lib/tensor/pytree.ts:145` `mdml-engine/tensor`

## tensor/ops

The tensor operations: arithmetic, comparisons and logic, mathematical functions, reductions, shape manipulation, indexing and sorting, and the linear algebra basics, each a differentiable primitive with numpy semantics. Part of `mdml-engine/tensor`.

- function `indexing.ts` (file): Slicing, take, gather, scatter and sort, all differentiable. `src/lib/tensor/ops/indexing.ts:1` `mdml-engine/tensor`
- function `linear.ts` (file): matmul, dot, tensordot, einsum and Kronecker products with batching. `src/lib/tensor/ops/linear.ts:1` `mdml-engine/tensor`
- function `math.ts` (file): Elementwise exp, log, trigonometric and hyperbolic functions with derivative rules. `src/lib/tensor/ops/math.ts:1` `mdml-engine/tensor`
- function `reduce.ts` (file): Sums, means, extrema, argmax, cumulative ops, softmax and logsumexp over axes. `src/lib/tensor/ops/reduce.ts:1` `mdml-engine/tensor`
- function `shape.ts` (file): Reshape, transpose, stack, concatenate and broadcasting. `src/lib/tensor/ops/shape.ts:1` `mdml-engine/tensor`
